notes: English base checkpoint (ModernBERT-large, 421M, ctx 512); the same HF repo carries multilingual/ and typed-decisions/ subfolders that this pin does not use.
Laya is an optional runtime dependency: without it, or with a version that does not match the pin, the extension fails open and records the failure reason.
The revision pins the huggingface_hub download; weights are cached by huggingface_hub and are never copied into this repository.
Values were recorded from the PyPI 0.3.20 release and the HF API revision endpoint; update them deliberately with the model, not by floating to main.
